title: no-swallowed-errors applies to newly added lines only
what: Tier 0 normally reports every finding in a changed file. Rules listed in anvil_ast::rules::NEW_CODE_ONLY_RULES (currently no-swallowed-errors) are filtered to lines the pending change adds, via retain_new_code_findings in anvil check and in the PostToolUse and Stop gates. A comment-only catch counts as swallowed; an intentional ignore needs `anvil-allow(no-swallowed-errors): <reason> [<ref>]`.
why: Calibration found dozens of legacy comment-only catches per real repo (Fliiper 89, ElMio 53, Orbit Labs 37). The user chose to block new slop without forcing a cleanup of old code on every nearby edit.
learned: tree-sitter-dart 0.3 puts handler blocks directly under try_statement, after a `type` or `catch_clause`, with no on_part node; finally wraps its own block in finally_clause. Known gap: a handler emptied by deleting its only statement adds no line, so it is not reported.
author: reactive-end
